data.professional_title: Product Owner | Business Analysis | Data-Driven Solutions
data.summary: Business Analyst / Product Owner with 10+ years of experience across capital markets, derivatives, banking, exchange, e-commerce, and consulting domains, delivering end-to-end solutions. Strong expertise in requirements elicitation (FSD/BRS/PRD), gap analysis, and data mapping, translating business needs into actionable product features. Proven track record in Agile and Waterfall delivery, leading Scrum ceremonies, backlog management, and full SDLC execution. Experienced in data analysis, reporting, and visualization, ensuring accurate implementation and business insights for decision-making. Demonstrated leadership in stakeholder management, cross-functional coordination, and production support, ensuring successful product delivery across global clients.

technical_skills: Business Analysis & Requirement Gathering (FSD, BRS, Use Cases)

responsibilities: Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Led end-to-end requirement elicitation using FSD/RSD, user stories, and gap analysis for BO/QV/QS reporting systems.
Data Mapping & Transformation: Performed complex data mapping across modules/views ensuring accurate report generation and logic validation.
Data Analysis & Reporting: Conducted data analysis and validation checks, ensuring correct implementation of reporting solutions.
Agile Delivery & Scrum: Facilitated scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, and backlog grooming, ensuring timely delivery across SDLC.
Stakeholder Management & Demos: Delivered demos and solution walkthroughs to stakeholders, ensuring alignment and requirement clarity.
UAT & Testing Support: Supported sanity testing, UAT preparation, and defect validation, ensuring quality releases.
Knowledge Management: Created and maintained knowledge repositories and reporting catalogues for reuse and standardization.
Solution Design & Requirements: Led requirements elicitation and solution design across multiple projects in regulatory and mortgage data domains.
Data Analysis & Insights: Queried and analyzed data to derive business insights and validate reporting logic.
Agile & Scrum Execution: Managed and participated in Agile ceremonies, ensuring delivery alignment and sprint success.
Reporting & Data Warehouse: Worked on data warehouse reporting, inbound/outbound data mapping, and regulatory reporting systems.
Documentation & Knowledge Repository: Developed FSDs, use cases, and knowledge repositories for improved delivery consistency.
UAT & Implementation Support: Supported UAT cycles, feasibility analysis, and implementation validation.
Product Backlog & Requirements Ownership: Owned end-to-end requirement lifecycle, acting as SPOC for business, dev, QA, and DB teams.
Agile Delivery & Scrum Master Role: Facilitated scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, and retrospectives, ensuring Agile adoption.
Change Management & Production Support: Led CMR process, deployment activities, and production issue resolution.
Test Case Review & UAT Support: Reviewed test cases and ensured quality assurance and successful releases.
Solution Design & Documentation: Created FSDs, data flow diagrams, use cases, mockups, and wireframes.
Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Managed stakeholders and vendors for POCs, requirement alignment, and delivery execution.
Trade Lifecycle: Good Knowledge of TLC as worked across requirements of various department of an Exchange
Agile & Waterfall Delivery: Managed projects across Agile and Waterfall methodologies, ensuring structured and timely execution.
Requirements & Solution Design: Developed FSDs, data flow diagrams, use cases, wireframes, and translated requirements for cross-functional teams.
Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Collaborated with stakeholders and vendors, managing POCs, requirement alignment, and delivery coordination.
Testing & Quality Assurance: Reviewed test cases, supported QA teams, and ensured quality delivery through validation and UAT support.
Change Management & Production Support: Handled CMR process, deployments, and production issue resolution, ensuring business continuity.
Market Strategy & Analysis: Developed go-to-market strategy for new business clusters and analyzed supplier performance.
Data Analysis & Insights: Gathered and analyzed supplier feedback to improve business efficiency and decision-making.
